definitions.gloss: operation; service; running (of trains, buses, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The scheduled operation of public transportation such as trains, buses, and other vehicles along their routes.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧{通|どお}り{運行|うんこう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The buses are running on their normal schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運行|うんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Train service was suspended due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{運行|うんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}する→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: A new bus route is scheduled to begin service next month.

notes:
USAGE:
{運行|うんこう} refers specifically to the operation of land-based transportation (trains, buses, streetcars). For ships and aircraft, ⟦{運航|うんこう}→運航：09229_unkou⟧ (with a different kanji) is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運行|うんこう}⟦ダイヤ→ダイヤ：00032_daiya⟧ (operating schedule/timetable)
- {運行|うんこう}{状況|じょうきょう} (service status)
- {運行|うんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再開|さいかい}する→再開する：25532_saikaisuru⟧ (to resume service)
- {運行|うんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見合|みあ}わせる→見合わせる：09450_miawaseru⟧ (to suspend service)
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{運行|うんこう} (special/extra service)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{運航|うんこう}→運航：09229_unkou⟧ uses the kanji {航|こう} (navigation) and applies to ships and aircraft. {運行|うんこう} uses {行|こう} (go) and applies to land transport. The readings are identical, so context and kanji are key.
